content.text:
This Outlook Scheduling Assistant screenshot shows the free/busy times of six attendees and the room NYC-14 Liberty (10) on Monday and Tuesday (all times New York time). I need to book a 60-minute meeting. Rules: Priya Shah and Marcus Lee are required; at least 2 of the other four (Nate Russo, Elena Ruiz, Rachel Cohen and Kenji Watanabe) must also be able to attend; tentative (hatched) blocks count as free, while busy and out-of-office blocks count as busy; the meeting must not overlap the 12:00-13:00 lunch hour; the room row must be free for the whole meeting; the meeting must lie within 9:00-17:00 and start on a quarter hour. What is the earliest start time that satisfies every rule? Answer as the day and the 24-hour start time, in the form `Tue 09:45` (three-letter day, HH:MM with a leading zero).

Think step by step. Then end your reply with one final line in exactly this form:
FINAL ANSWER: <your answer>

**Room NYC-14 Liberty (busy blocks, approximate):**
- Mon: busy 8:00–8:30, 10:15–11:30, 13:15–14:00, 15:00–15:45, 16:15–17:15
- Tue: busy 8:30–9:30, 13:30–14:00, 14:15–15:15, 16:00–17:00, 17:15–17:45

**Monday:** The room is free only in 9:00–10:15, 11:30–13:15, 14:00–15:00 and 15:45–16:15. Each candidate fails:
- 9:00–10:00: Nate is free, but Elena, Rachel and Kenji are busy. Only one of the four is available.
- 9:15–10:15: Elena is free, but Nate (10:00), Rachel (busy until 9:30) and Kenji (9:15–10:00) conflict. Only one is available.
- 9:30 or later: the room is busy at 10:15.
- 14:00–15:00: Marcus is busy from 14:45.
- The other windows are shorter than 60 minutes once lunch is excluded.

Monday has no valid slot.

**Tuesday:** The room is free in 9:30–12:00 (lunch excluded), 13:00–13:30, 14:00–14:15, 15:15–16:00 and 17:00–17:15. Only 9:30–12:00 can hold a 60-minute meeting. Marcus is busy from 11:15, so the meeting must end by 11:15 or start by 10:15 at the latest.
- 9:30–10:30: Nate is busy 10:00–10:45, Elena is busy 9:45–11:15, Kenji is busy 9:30–10:15. Only Rachel is available.
- 9:45–10:45: Nate, Elena and Kenji all conflict. Only Rachel is available.
- 10:00–11:00: Nate, Elena and Kenji conflict (Kenji is busy until 10:15). Only Rachel is available.
- **10:15–11:15:**
  - Priya is free (her Data sync is tentative and ends at 10:15; she is busy from 11:30).
  - Marcus is free (his tentative block ends at 10:45; he is busy from 11:15, which is exactly the end).
  - The room is free (busy from 9:30 to 13:30 only, outside this window).
  - Nate is busy 10:00–10:45, so he is out.
  - Elena is busy until 11:15, so she is out.
  - Rachel is free (her only morning block ends at 9:15; her Training is tentative).
  - Kenji is free (his busy block ends at 10:15; 10:15–11:00 is tentative).
  - Rachel and Kenji together satisfy the "at least two of four" rule.

The earliest valid start is **Tue 10:15**.

FINAL ANSWER: Tue 10:15
